text:
alyssa: Heads-up — I unpinned the gpufleet module in staging to test a KMS key_type param change. PR merged ~5m ago but autoscaler isn't picking up new nodes.
infra-bot: pipeline: apply succeeded for env=staging (commit abc123). :white_check_mark:
miguel: can you paste the terraform plan that landed? mainly want to see provider blocks and kms changes.
alyssa: plan summary: module.gpufleet.version 1.4.2 -> 1.5.0, and we added `kms_key_type = \"hsm\"` as an optional var. no explicit provider alias churn that i can see.
priya: i'm seeing nodes created but without the `gpu-type=rtx` label. cluster-autoscaler ignores them. looks like bootstrap (or AMI) changed in 1.5.0.
alyssa: here's `kubectl get nodes --show-labels` output from a new instance:
```
ip-10-0-3-45   Ready    <none>   14h   v1.25.3   kubelet=1.25.3   beta.kubernetes.io/arch=amd64,gpu-type=
ip-10-0-3-46   Ready    <none>   4m    v1.25.3   kubelet=1.25.3   beta.kubernetes.io/arch=amd64,gpu-type=rtx
```
(the problem nodes are missing label)
raj: check the node bootstrap logs (cloud-init / user-data). if userdata uses KMS decrypt and the instance role can't decrypt the new key, cloud-init will bail and skip label set.
alyssa: user-data log from failing node:
```
2026-02-25T14:12:09Z cloud-init[1234]: ERROR: KMS Decrypt failed: InvalidCiphertextException: Unable to decrypt
2026-02-25T14:12:09Z cloud-init[1234]: aborting bootstrap
```
miguel: that matches: module 1.5.0 switches to a customer-managed KMS key and we didn't grant the instance role kms:Decrypt for the new key alias. easy fix: add kms:Decrypt to the node instance profile for the key ARN/alias.
priya: if we patch IAM manually in staging, GitOps might detect drift and try to revert it later. do we want to patch or roll back the module pin to 1.4.2?
emma: proposal: Temporary IAM patch in staging (manual) so existing nodes can bootstrap. Then publish a small module release that keeps old behavior by default and documents the KMS principal change. After that, do a proper gitops PR that updates IAM intentionally.
alyssa: i'll open a hotfix PR to add kms:Decrypt to the instance profile in staging and also prepare a rollback path (pin gpufleet to 1.4.2 on the canary branch) if things go sideways. making PR now.
deploy-bot: PR created: #4822 by alyssa — "staging: allow kms decrypt for instance profile"
miguel: also add a post-apply smoke test to the gitops pipeline: after apply spawn a test node, assert it joins and has gpu-type=rtx. catches this class of change earlier.
priya: :thumbsup: agree. we should add a small e2e step in the post-apply hook.
alyssa: update: patched IAM in staging, terminating a test instance to force repro. will report back when node registers.
infra-bot: instance i-0abcde restarted, joined cluster, labels: gpu-type=rtx, status Ready.
alyssa: confirmed — cluster-autoscaler picked it up and started scheduling GPU pods. closing for staging but we need a module migration note and changelog entry about KMS principal for node roles.
